question: If '+' means 'subtraction', '÷' means 'addition', '–' means 'multiplication' and '×' means 'division', then what is the value of (8 + 2 –19) – (4 + 27 × 3)?
solution:
Given expression: (8 + 2 –19) – (4 + 27 × 3)

And sign changes are as follow-

• '+' → '–'

• '÷' → '+'

• '–' → '×'

• '×' → '÷'

On changing signs, given expression becomes: (8 – 2 × 19) × (4 – 27 ÷ 3)

Solve using BODMAS-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75e315c5c5f7ac83b74231e0ae7be21a89d19ad6f442a899a161087b7697e801.png] 

(8 – 2 × 19) × (4 – 27 ÷ 3)

= (8 – 38) × (4 – 9)

= (– 30) × (– 5)

= 150

Hence, **'option 4' **is the correct answer.
